title: Hazel and the Harbor
author: Rosalind Winterbourne
blurb: Juniper Lockridge, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
